pre_opening.note: Dated before public opening. Most are press, donor, and Founding Member preview visits and are entirely legitimate. Only the low-rated ones below are worth a human look.

triage.author: Wells S
triage.text: Worst grilled cheese I’ve ever had in my entire life.

triage.author: Gage
triage.text: The bison sandwich was mediocre and the whole place was overpriced.

triage.author: Bryan Donaldson
triage.text: The “kabob” was not a kabob it was a salad and it was not good

triage.author: Rich NunYaBusiness
triage.text: Skip it unless it's late and you have to feed the kids. Horrible PB&J sandwich, take dry summer camp peanut butter and flavorless jelly, slap it between two giant flavorless pieces of bread and you have a recipe for a desert in your mouth. Good luck swallowing. Bison sandwich was almost as bad dry slices of bison. I finally opened it up, took the meat off, scraped the sauce off the bread and spread it on the meat and just ate that.

triage.author: Kath Williams
triage.text: Chili was good. Small portions for the price. A cup of chili was $10. Soda and water by the can $4.75. Overpriced and underwhelming. Sandwiches and wraps were $20+.

triage.author: Brittany Scott
triage.text: Food was way too expensive for the quality. They really need to re-think the style and logistics of this Cafe.

triage.author: Lisa Field
triage.text: I ordered a sour dough grilled Bison sandwich. I could not bite or chew the Bison so took it off and paid $23 for 2 slices of sourdough. Brought the meat back to camp to give to the dog so at least it wasn't wasted. Green Chile Pazole was edible but did not taste as good as I've had it prepared by my Hispanic friends.

triage.author: Bruce Bartholomew
triage.text: So the grab and go is the only option for the last three hours that the Library is open. Really disappointed because the menu sounded amazing but don't expect to be able to order off of it. As others have said, they need to figure out their pricing and service

triage.author: Eileen McAuley
triage.text: We had to wait 10 minutes on line to then find out when we get to the front they are not taking orders because kitchen is backed up. No estimate on when they will open up again, took another 20 minutes. Eat before you come

triage.author: George Heinrichs
triage.text: Very limited and poorly chosen menu for my tastes; food was edible but not enjoyable- a great library but some questionable choices on food - potatoes salad was bland and frozen, grilled cheese was more like two separately toasted bread slices with two cheese slices slapped in the middle (not melted, possibly never exposed to heat) - advertised as Havarti but clearly had other cheese; no chips; no fries; just no choices

triage.author: C J
triage.text: Okay, so—this cafe needs some fine tuning. We visited today, on a Monday between meal times and it was a logistical nightmare. The line cuts in front of the access to the bathroom, the gals taking orders seemed deeply overwhelmed, some of the orders were being called out by number from the counter, some were being served by food runners. Someone needs to shuffle the whole cafe around, have a more efficient line situation, and hire more hands for the kitchen and coffee area. I think the food has EXCELLENT potential, we only had coffee and a cookie (which was very good!) but the logistics and serving situation need to be fine tuned. I hope they get some of the details ironed out before we visit again. Lots and lots of potential, but have patience if you visit anytime soon!

triage.author: Bridget
triage.text: The food is outstanding. The only reason I took off one star is their failure to update their Google listing. Take note!! Only limited “Grab n Go” after 3:00pm.
